assertions_evaluated.text: Every one of the three helper commands has a literal launcher path and literal argument values, with no shell variable or ${...} expansion anywhere in the command
assertions_evaluated.evidence: All three commands use '.claude/scripts/...' and literal values; no variable

assertions_evaluated.text: In every one of the three helper commands the launcher path and each substituted value (plugin root, run directory, merge base, base, scope, index path) is single-quoted
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Launcher, '/tmp/tmp.abc', merge base, 'main', 'plugins/git-kit' and GIT_INDEX_FILE='/tmp/tmp.abc/index' are all single-quoted

assertions_evaluated.text: The plugin root value is obtained from its own printf '%s\n' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.claude}" call, not echo, never from the plugins/ folder of the repository under review
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 0 runs printf as its own call; 'Use printf, not echo'; never the plugins/ folder

assertions_evaluated.text: The planner re-run sets GIT_INDEX_FILE to the literal /tmp/tmp.abc/index as a prefix assignment on the same command
assertions_evaluated.evidence: GIT_INDEX_FILE='/tmp/tmp.abc/index' prefix on the planner call

assertions_evaluated.text: A SCOPE value containing a single quote stops the step with a question to the user instead of being typed into a command
assertions_evaluated.evidence: 'Stop and ask the user; do not escape, re-quote, trim or guess it'

assertions_evaluated.text: A call that is still refused in the literal form is stopped and reported, with no other way of running the step
assertions_evaluated.evidence: 'Stop and report the refused call and its message. Do not fall back to another way'
